name: Craftsman's Writ: Thick Leather Ammo Pouch

aliases: what does the writ ask for
faq.answer: The document calls for a single thick leather ammo pouch to be delivered along with the writ itself.
The note marks itself as transferable, so anyone who holds the paper can fill the order and collect payment.

aliases: where do i take the pouch
faq.answer: The writ specifies a delivery location and payment terms for whoever brings the requested goods.

sections.body: A faded note sets out a trade order for a thick leather ammo pouch. Whoever holds the transferable paper can carry the crafted pouch to the marked destination and claim the agreed payment.
sections.title: A Commercial Order

summary: A transferable craftsman's writ calls for a thick leather ammo pouch to be brought to a designated buyer. Fulfilling the order yields the payment promised on the parchment.
attribution: In-game quest text: Craftsman's Writ: Thick Leather Ammo Pouch
